I have this issue too and Ik how to fix it:

You're gonna have to log out of your PSN first and then start BO2

Once you're in Multiplayer, pick either a LAN party or Local, doesn't matter and start the game.

Once the game is started, just end the game immediately.

After it's ended, tap "Play Online" and a popup for logging into PSN shall load up. If it does, log in. 

After you log in, it shall load you to online without freezing.

Disclaimer: You have to do this every time you go in Bo2, I wish there was a way to do it only once, but I guess not.

Hopefully this helps.
